description: This file contains unit tests for the Enricher classes in the org.apache.fineract.investor.event package, specifically testing data enrichment behavior for various Loan-related Data Transfer Objects.

classes.name: EnricherTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the functionality of various data enricher classes used within the Fineract project for loan-related data objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes thread local context with tenant info, action context, and business dates before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets the thread local context after each test.

methods.name: testLoanAccountDataEnricher
methods.description: Tests that LoanAccountDataV1Enricher correctly enriches data with external owner ID, settlement date, and purchase price ratio.

methods.name: testLoanChargeDataEnricher
methods.description: Verifies that LoanChargeDataV1Enricher correctly sets external owner ID during enrichment.

methods.name: testLoanTransactionDataEnricher
methods.description: Checks that LoanTransactionDataV1Enricher properly assigns external owner ID when enriching LoanTransactionDataV1 objects.

methods.name: testAllEventEnricherWorksCorrectly
methods.description: Ensures all enrichers work together correctly, and their individual support checks behave as expected when enriching a LoanAccountDataV1 object.
